lay_on_hands.name: Lay on Hands
description: Heals a friendly target for an amount
equal to 10 HP for each rank in 'Healer'.

heal_with_herbs.name: Heal with Herbs
description: Heals a friendly target for an amount
equal to 20 HP for each rank in 'Healer'.

perform_beauty.name: Perform Beauty
description: Increases your party's 'Chance to hit' for each
rank in 'Troubadour', as long as you are performing.
A high increase to low hit chances,
a low increase to already high hit chances.

perform_chaos.name: Perform Chaos
description: Decreases the enemy's 'Chance to hit' for each
rank in 'Troubadour', as long as you are performing.
A high decrease to high hit chances,
a low decrease to already low hit chances.
